freeze_scripted_module: freeze a TorchScript module to inline submodules and parameters as constants
freeze_preserve_attributes: freeze a TorchScript module while preserving specified attributes for runtime modification
run_frozen_optimizations: run optimization passes on a frozen TorchScript graph to remove dropout and fold conv-batchnorm
optimize_for_inference: optimize a scripted module for inference with environment-specific optimizations like MKLDNN
test_freeze_eval_mode: test that freezing a ScriptModule requires eval mode and raises RuntimeError otherwise
